bundleImport.title: Import question ZIP bundle
bundleImport.subtitle: You can upload a .csv file or a .zip bundle from ort-digitizer (questions + images + manifest.json).
bundleImport.detectedZip: ZIP bundle selected: questions, images and manifest.json are checked together.
bundleImport.languageNote: For a ZIP bundle the language is taken from manifest.json. The language selected here is only used for bundles without manifest.json.
bundleImport.examSetAuto: A separate exam "exam_bundle_<source_id>" is created automatically for each source (source_id). Re-uploading a corrected bundle updates the same questions instead of creating duplicates.
bundleImport.okTitle: The bundle passed validation and can be imported
bundleImport.examSetExisting: already exists and will be updated
bundleImport.rowHint: The row number is the data row in the CSV (the header is not counted), as in manifest.json.

errors.manifest_count_mismatch: manifest.json lists {expected} questions, the CSV has {got}

errors.csv_field_count: The row has {got} fields instead of 15

errors.image_missing: Image "{image}" was not found in the bundle

errors.image_unused: The image is not used by any question
errors.questions_missing_from_bundle: {count} previously imported questions from source "{sourceId}" are not in this bundle and were left unchanged
errors.firestore_mirror_failed: The questions were saved, but copying to Firestore failed

list.title: My courses
list.becomeTeacherText: Want to run your own courses? Ask for teacher access.
list.emptyTeaching: You are not teaching any courses yet.
list.emptyLearning: You have not joined any courses yet. Use a code from your teacher.

join.title: Join a course
join.hint: Enter the code your teacher gave you.

home.draftNotice: This course is a draft. Students cannot join until you publish it.
home.contentSoon: Lessons and assignments will appear here in a future update.
home.leaveBody: You will lose access. You can join again with a valid code.

people.name: Name
people.removeBody: {name} will lose access to this course.

settings.joinCodeHint: Share this code with your students. It works only while the course is published and enrollment is by code.
settings.joinCodeInactive: The code is not active right now: publish the course and set enrollment to a join code.
settings.regenerateBody: The old code stops working immediately. Students already in the course are not affected.

lifecycleHint.draft: The course is a draft and hidden from students.
lifecycleHint.published: The course is published. Students can join with the code.
lifecycleHint.concluded: The course is concluded. Nobody can join.

settings.unpublishBody: The course returns to draft. This only works when there are no active students.
settings.concludeBody: Nobody will be able to join. You can reopen the course later.
settings.noOtherTeachers: No other teachers in this course
settings.transferBody: The new owner gets full control of the course. You stay a teacher.
settings.transferHint: Only a teacher already in this course can become the owner.
settings.deleteBody: The course disappears for everyone. You can restore it from deleted courses.
settings.deleteHint: Only the owner can delete or restore a course.

trash.title: Deleted courses
trash.hint: Courses you own that you deleted. Restoring returns a course as a draft.

teacherRequest.title: Become a teacher
teacherRequest.intro: Teachers can create courses and invite students. Send a request and a platform administrator will review it.
teacherRequest.approvedBody: You are an approved teacher and can create courses.
teacherRequest.pendingBody: Your request is waiting for review. You will see the result here.
teacherRequest.revokedBody: Your teacher access was revoked. Your existing courses stay available. You may send a new request.
teacherRequest.rejectedBody: Your last request was rejected. You may send a new one.
teacherRequest.messagePlaceholder: Where you teach, which subjects, why you need courses.

notAuthorized.title: Not authorized
notAuthorized.body: This area is only for platform administrators.

overview.title: Platform administration
overview.usersHint: Search accounts, change teacher status, disable accounts.
overview.coursesHint: Moderate courses: unlist, delete, restore, transfer.
overview.auditHint: Every administrator action is recorded here.

requests.title: Teacher requests
requests.rejectBody: The user will see your reason and can apply again later.
requests.revokeBody: The person can no longer create courses or become a teacher in other courses. Existing courses stay unchanged.

users.title: Users
users.disableBody: The user is signed out immediately and cannot log in. Their courses and enrollments are kept.

courses.title: Courses
courses.transferHint: The new owner must be an approved, enabled teacher. Paste their user ID from the users page.
courses.rosterAudited: Viewing the roster is recorded in the audit log.

bank.notAuthorized: The question bank is available only to the teachers and assistants of this course.
bank.concluded: This course is concluded, so content is read-only.

list.title: Question banks
list.empty: No question banks yet. Create the first one or import questions.
list.deleteBody: The bank and its questions are hidden. You can restore it from the trash. Quizzes that already use these questions keep working.

questions.deleteBody: The question is hidden and can be restored. Quizzes and attempts that already use it are not affected.

single_choice.name: Single choice
single_choice.hint: One correct answer among 2 to 10 choices.

multiple_answers.name: Multiple answers
multiple_answers.hint: Several correct answers among the choices.

true_false.name: True / false
true_false.hint: The student decides whether the statement is true.

comparison.name: Comparison (Column A vs B)
comparison.hint: Quantitative comparison with fixed answer choices.

numeric.name: Numeric answer
numeric.hint: The student types a number. Exact values with a margin or ranges are accepted.

short_text.name: Short text
short_text.hint: The student types a short answer that is compared with accepted answers.

essay.name: Essay
essay.hint: Free-form answer that a teacher reviews manually.

editor.title: Question (version {n})
editor.numericHint: Use a dot or a comma as the decimal separator. Any matching answer gets full points.
editor.shortHint: One accepted answer per line. Spaces and letter case are normalized.
editor.rubricHint: Essays are graded by hand after the quiz.
editor.errPoints: Enter the points as a number, zero or more.
editor.errChoiceEmpty: Every choice needs text or an image.
editor.errCorrect: Mark at least one correct choice.
editor.errAnswers: Add at least one accepted answer.

image.hint: Choose a file, drop it here or paste from the clipboard. PNG, JPEG, GIF or WEBP, up to 5 MB.
image.alreadyUploaded: This image was already uploaded, so the existing copy is used.
image.noImages: You have no uploaded images yet.

history.pick: Pick a version on the left to compare it with the current one.
history.revertBody: A new version is created with this content. Older versions stay in the history.
history.reverted: Reverted. A new version was created.

conflict.title: Someone else changed this
conflict.body: This item was saved by another person since you opened it. Reload to see the latest version. Your unsaved edits will be lost.

translations.none: This question has no linked translations yet.
translations.unlinkBody: The question stays as it is but is no longer a translation of the others.
translations.addHint: Creates a copy of this question in another language of the course. Translate the copy afterwards.
translations.noResults: No matching questions of the same type without a translation group.

passages.title: Title (optional)
passages.lineHelp: Start a line with [5], [10] and so on to show a line number there. Without markers every fifth line is numbered. Formulas use $...$.
passages.noQuestions: No questions use this passage yet.
passages.deleteBody: A passage that questions still use cannot be deleted.
